facts: Planning Data local-plan guidance defines four required datasets
The four datasets are local plan local plan boundary local plan document and local plan timetable
OGC WFS may be used to serve local-plan data
ArcGIS API may be used to serve local-plan data
Local plan dataset represents plans prepared by a local planning authority
Local plan boundary dataset represents the area a plan covers
Planning Data asks plan-boundary geometry as polygon or multipolygon
WGS84 is preferred for local-plan boundary geometry
Local plan document dataset represents plan documents or supporting documents
New published documents should be added to the document dataset
Local-plan new data was last found 24 July 2026
Local-plan origin is currently MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
Local-plan dataset contains current emerging and historical plans
Local-plan data can help check whether a plan is still in date
Local-plan data can link to detailed plan information
Local-plan-boundary new data was last found 18 March 2026
Local-plan-boundary origin is currently MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement
